## Instructions

1. Mix flour and salt.
2. Cut in the shortening with a pastry blender until crumbly.
3. Beat the egg in a measuring cup, add vinegar and fill with ice water.
4. Stir liquid in with a fork, a little at a time. Do not overwork.
5. Divide into balls, wrap, chill at least 30 minutes before rolling.

## Notes

"Never fails!"
